title: Sunnahs for dealing with one’s wife
subtitle: Prophetic etiquette for married life

items.title: The smile on the wife's face
items.text: Your smile in the face of your family is part of good treatment, and the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Your smile in the face of your brother is charity for you.

items.title: Flattering with kind words
items.text: It is Sunnah for the husband to address his wife with kind words and gentle calls that soothe her heart.
items.source: The guidance of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him

items.title: Show love
items.text: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, declared his love for Aisha, may God be pleased with her, and this taught husbands to show affection, not hide it.

items.title: Justice and mercy
items.text: It is good treatment for the home to be based on justice and mercy, not on harshness and tyranny.

items.title: Family service
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, was in the profession of his family, and when the time for prayer came, he went out to pray.

items.title: Be patient with mistakes
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, said: A believing man should not be separated from a believing woman. If he dislikes one of her characteristics, he will be pleased with another.

items.title: The gift brings joy
items.text: Love each other, and a gift between spouses is a door of affection and renewal of familiarity.

items.title: Keep the secret
items.text: One of the greatest guarantees is keeping the secrets of marital life and not publishing what happens between the spouses.

items.title: Adornment for the wife
items.text: Just as a man likes his wife to adorn herself for him, it is a part of the perfection of the relationship that he takes care of his appearance and cleanliness for her.

items.title: Consultation
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, consulted with Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, on the day of Hudaybiyyah, and this indicates the virtue of consulting the wife and respecting her opinion.

items.title: Kindness in treatment
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, said: Kindness is not in anything except that it beautifies it, and is not removed from anything except that it distorts it.

items.title: Alimony is reasonable
items.text: The best expenditure is what a man spends on his family seeking reward, as it is charity, reward and connection.

items.title: Introducing pleasure
items.text: A beautiful word, a kind attitude, and sincere attention strengthen the affection between spouses.

items.title: Ignoring mistakes
items.text: Not every lapse requires censure, and it is good manners to ignore what does not corrupt religion or truth.

items.title: Praying for the wife
items.text: It is loyalty for the husband to pray for his wife’s goodness, guidance, and blessing in secret and in public.

items.title: Respect its people
items.text: Honoring the wife’s family and speaking well of them is a complete way to honor her and preserve her thoughts.

items.title: Teach gently
items.text: If the wife needs advice or education, let it be done gently, discreetly and wisely.

items.title: Do not hit or insult
items.text: The Messenger of God, peace and blessings be upon him, never hit a woman, and he was the most merciful of people to his family.

items.title: Helping her when she is tired
items.text: Helping the wife at home and taking care of the children is a sign of compassion and not a lack of manhood.

items.title: Good listening
items.text: Listening to the wife and understanding her needs is a door to peace and affection.

items.title: Permissible joking
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, used to be kind to his family, and good humor alleviated the hardship of life and brought hearts closer together.
items.source: The guidance of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him

items.title: Tolerance when angry
items.text: If a dispute occurs, the Sunnah is to suppress anger and refrain from hurtful speech until the souls calm down.

items.title: Thanks and appreciation
items.text: He who does not thank people does not thank God, and thanking his wife for her kindness increases love.

items.title: Moderate jealousy
items.text: Praiseworthy jealousy protects the house, but mistrust and oppression are not part of good treatment.

items.title: Good farewell and reception
items.text: Greetings and kind words when entering and leaving make a great impact at home.

items.title: Cooperation in obedience
items.text: One of the most beautiful things that couples have in common is that they help each other in prayer, remembrance, and doing good.

items.title: Covering up when in disagreement
items.text: Marital disputes are dealt with with wisdom and concealment, and are not made a topic of conversation for people.

items.title: Loyalty when sick
items.text: Taking care of the wife when she is sick and consoling her is one of the truest forms of mercy.

items.title: Sweetening the mind
items.text: Apologizing when you make a mistake and being kind to each other preserves affection and prevents the accumulation of estrangement.

items.title: Building serenity
items.text: God created love and mercy between spouses, so every word and action that achieves tranquility is part of good treatment.
